newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO in China iron joint venture.
newsitem.headline: POSCO in China iron joint venture.

text.p: Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) of South Korea said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with two Chinese firms to build a continuous galvanised iron (CGI) plant in Guangdong, China, by the first half of 1998.

POSCO said in a statement it would invest $11.39 million and hold an 80 percent stake in the venture. Guangdong Merchant and Industrial Corp and Economic Development Co Inc would have 10 percent each. The joint venture company would be called "Shunde Pohang Coated Steel Co Ltd".
The construction of the plant, which would have an annual production capacity of 100,000 tonnes, would start in March 1997, it said.
Continuous galvanised iron is used as raw material for construction and making home appliances.
